command: set -eu; S=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$S"; adb -s "$S" push app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk /data/local/tmp/aicallbridge-shell-probe.apk >/dev/null; adb -s "$S" shell 'CLASSPATH=/data/local/tmp/aicallbridge-shell-probe.apk app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.ShellAudioProbe'
